purpose: Offline routing expectations for new research figures and ordinary-diagram negative cases; no model outcomes are asserted.

cases.prompt: Create a new latency comparison plot for our systems paper from measured values.
cases.reason: Publication plots use the paper figure pipeline and its new-figure defaults.

cases.prompt: Regenerate our existing throughput plot from its current script and keep its appearance.
cases.reason: Regeneration preserves an existing figure unless restyling is requested.

cases.prompt: Create a new systems paper plot at the venue's required 3.4-inch width.
cases.reason: The explicit venue width overrides the 3.3-inch research default.

cases.prompt: Make a new editable .drawio architecture figure for our paper.
cases.reason: The native format selects Draw.io; the research composition applies.

cases.prompt: Draw a new editable workflow figure for our systems paper; no native format is prescribed. Native acceptance for all three OmniGraffle templates passed on this Mac and the current scripting probe responds.
cases.reason: After native acceptance and a fresh responsive probe, a new research workflow with no selected owner prefers OmniGraffle.

cases.prompt: Create a new editable architecture overview for our systems paper. No source format is specified. OmniGraffle native acceptance passed on this Mac and its current scripting probe responds.
cases.reason: The accepted native research preference includes architecture figures.

cases.prompt: Create a new cache/memory mechanism detail for our systems paper. No source format is specified. OmniGraffle native acceptance passed on this Mac and its current scripting probe responds.
cases.reason: The accepted native research preference includes mechanism figures.

cases.prompt: Draw a new systems-paper workflow with no format specified; OmniGraffle's active scripting probe is unavailable here.
cases.reason: The implicit OmniGraffle preference can fall back to Draw.io when native drawing readiness is unverified, with the fallback disclosed.

cases.prompt: Draw our new systems-paper workflow as an editable .drawio file.
cases.reason: The requested native Draw.io format overrides the OmniGraffle workflow preference.

cases.prompt: Add a new workflow figure to our paper project, which requires .drawio source files.
cases.reason: The project source convention overrides the OmniGraffle workflow preference.

cases.prompt: Use OmniGraffle for our paper workflow figure even if native automation is unavailable on this Mac.
cases.reason: The explicit native owner remains OmniGraffle; prepare the editable request and report blocked native output instead of silently using Draw.io.

cases.prompt: Fix one connector in this existing .graffle document without restyling it.
cases.reason: The existing native document keeps its established appearance.

cases.prompt: Draw a graphical architecture map for a website deployment; this is not a paper figure.
cases.reason: Ordinary graphical architecture retains Archify's general defaults.

cases.prompt: Draw a graphical workflow map for an ordinary deployment, not a paper figure.
cases.reason: Ordinary workflow maps retain Archify's graphical default.

cases.prompt: Render this ordinary Mermaid flowchart A --> B using the current default theme.
cases.reason: Explicit Mermaid uses Pretty Mermaid without research restyling.
